formulas.title: Cayley-Hamilton & Eigenvalue Properties
formulas.summary: Every square matrix satisfies its own characteristic equation: \(P(\lambda) = |A - \lambda I| = 0\).
formulas.latexSnippet:
$$\det(A - \lambda I) = (-1)^n \lambda^n + c_{n-1}\lambda^{n-1} + \dots + c_0 = 0$$

$$\text{By Cayley-Hamilton: } (-1)^n A^n + c_{n-1}A^{n-1} + \dots + c_0 I = 0$$

$$\text{Inverse Matrix: } A^{-1} = -\frac{1}{c_0} \left( (-1)^n A^{n-1} + c_{n-1}A^{n-2} + \dots + c_1 I \right)$$

$$\sum_{i=1}^n \lambda_i = \text{Trace}(A), \quad \prod_{i=1}^n \lambda_i = \det(A)$$

formulas.title: Second-Order ODE Solutions (Complementary Function)
formulas.summary: Standard auxiliary equation roots classification for \(a \frac{d^2y}{dx^2} + b \frac{dy}{dx} + c y = 0\).
formulas.latexSnippet:
$$a m^2 + b m + c = 0$$

$$\text{Case 1 (Real & Distinct } m_1 \neq m_2): \quad y = C_1 e^{m_1 x} + C_2 e^{m_2 x}$$

$$\text{Case 2 (Real & Repeated } m_1 = m_2 = m): \quad y = (C_1 + C_2 x) e^{m x}$$

$$\text{Case 3 (Complex Conjugate } \alpha \pm i\beta): \quad y = e^{\alpha x} (C_1 \cos \beta x + C_2 \sin \beta x)$$

formulas.title: Two-Variable Extrema & Saddle Point Conditions
formulas.summary: Second-derivative test discriminant for finding maxima, minima, and saddle points.
formulas.latexSnippet:
$$r = f_{xx}, \quad s = f_{xy}, \quad t = f_{yy}, \quad \Delta = rt - s^2$$

$$\Delta > 0 \text{ and } r > 0 \implies \text{Local Minimum at } (a, b)$$

$$\Delta > 0 \text{ and } r < 0 \implies \text{Local Maximum at } (a, b)$$

$$\Delta < 0 \implies \text{Saddle Point at } (a, b)$$

$$\Delta = 0 \implies \text{Inconclusive (Further investigation needed)}$$

formulas.title: Infinite Series Convergence Tests
formulas.summary: Quick tests for infinite series convergence used in SRMIST Part A and Part B questions.
formulas.latexSnippet:
$$\text{D'Alembert's Ratio Test: } L = \lim_{n \to \infty} \left| \frac{a_{n+1}}{a_n} \right| \quad (L < 1 \text{ conv}, L > 1 \text{ div})$$

$$\text{Cauchy's Root Test: } L = \lim_{n \to \infty} \sqrt[n]{|a_n|} \quad (L < 1 \text{ conv}, L > 1 \text{ div})$$

$$\text{p-Series Test: } \sum_{n=1}^\infty \frac{1}{n^p} \quad (p > 1 \text{ conv}, p \le 1 \text{ div})$$
